title: PUBLISIND public-sector pay protest series, physical gathering reported Dec. 31
notes: News.ro and RRA state that PUBLISIND protests began with physical gatherings on Dec. 31. RRA confirms a Jan. 13 action; Zi de Zi confirms a separate Jan. 20 Mureș gathering; the Satu Mare Prefecture retrospectively confirms a Jan. 27 local gathering. The organizer scheduled weekly actions at changing locations. These are separate dated assemblies; the record does not assert continuous physical occupation or resolve whether a broader recurring-series episode spans dates. Dec. 31 remains a prior-month physical onset, not an automatic January merge. BNS (Jan. 19) and SNST (Feb. 1) reproduce later dated plans; they support a recurring scheduled series, not continuous occupation or execution at every site.
